structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Enforcement, Collection, Refund, Remedies and Review of State Taxes

law.text: If the final order of the court in any proceeding under §§ 58.1-1825 through 58.1-1828 grants the relief prayed for, no costs shall be taxed against the applicant; but in no event shall any costs be taxed against the Commonwealth in any proceeding under such sections.
